name: embed-consent
title: Embed consent
description: A gate for third-party embeds: it names the provider and what it receives, and loads the iframe only after the visitor agrees, with a way to remember and revoke.
docs: Put the provider's iframe in children: it is not rendered, so it makes no request, until the visitor presses Load content. provider names who runs it and is also the key a 'yes, always' is stored under (localStorage under rhs-ui:embed-consent:<provider>, one answer per provider, shared by every embed of it and every tab). remember='always' (default) adds the checkbox; remember='once' stores nothing. receives lists what the provider gets, in short phrases: name what yours really sends. After loading, focus moves to the iframe and a line under it offers Revoke consent (or Hide, when the answer was not remembered); pressing it brings the placeholder back, puts focus on Load content and says 'Content from <provider> hidden.' to a screen reader (labels.hidden). Pass consented, onConsent and onRevoke to let your own consent manager decide instead; the component then stores nothing. The server renders the placeholder, so a returning visitor's embed arrives right after hydration.
